title: calendula suffruticosa subsp. maritima
intro: Calendula suffruticosa subsp. maritima, commonly known as sea marigold, is a subspecies of the calendula plant that is native to coastal areas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe wounds, reduce skin irritation, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of calendula suffruticosa subsp. maritima include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, carotenoids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its effectiveness in promoting tissue repair, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
